scenes.setting: Pleasure turned weapon: the Duke's heart nearly bursts, the Wind-blessed smashes through a wall, and the blond secretary seals the attic — chaos-scattered fireballs, a split silhouette, and the Devil's 'Die!' half-reflected back so both cough clots of rusted blood
scenes.text_anchor: This was a devil walking the earth!

scenes.setting: The conch is blown and no Archbishop comes; the mistress smiles, jumps and cracks her skull on the concrete — and the Duke's own terror kills him where he lies while panicking guards shoot wildly and die on the Wind-blessed's blades. The roses in the greenhouse are still in full bloom
scenes.text_anchor: He was robbed of his life by his own horror.

scenes.setting: The secretary's grief opens his own seal; by the time he turns back, Devil and suitcase are gone — and along his prepared escape route the Desire Apostle finds a thick sea of blood rising before his eyes
scenes.text_anchor: a thick sea of blood seemed to appear before his eyes
